images.filename: Aircraft washing- not your average bubble bath (11594971405).jpg
images.caption: Airman 1st Class Courtney Swain pulls water-proof tape off of an F-16 Fighting Falcon after a routine cleaning Oct. 28, 2013, at Shaw Air Force Base, S.C. The tape ensures that water does not get into places that could be damaged during the jets cleaning at the wash-rack. Swain is a 20th Aircraft Maintenance Squadron weapons apprentice. (U.S. Air Force photo by Airman 1st Class Jensen Stidham/Released)
